title: PaymentCreditLinePayment - Data API
description: A payment credit line payment. This object is available in API version 65.0 and later.

Amount.description: Amount to apply to or unapply from the payment to the credit. This is a required field.

AppliedDate.description: Date payment was applied. Can be the current date or a provided date.

AssociatedAccountId.description: ID of the customer account. This field is a relationship field.

AssociatedLineId.description: ID of the associated line. This field is a relationship field.

CurrencyIsoCode.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
CurrencyIsoCode.description: Contains the ISO code for any currency allowed by the organization. Possible values are: EUR—Euro GBP—British Pound USD—U.S. Dollar The default value is USD.

Description.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

HasBeenUnapplied.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
HasBeenUnapplied.description: Indicates whether the refund line record with type Applied has been unapplied. Not applicable for a refund line record with type Unapplied. This is a required field.

LastReferencedDate.description: Timestamp for when the current user last viewed a record related to this record.

LastViewedDate.description: Timestamp for when the current user last viewed this record. If this value is null, it’s possible that this record was referenced (LastReferencedDate) and not viewed.

PaymentCreditId.description: ID of the payment credit. This field is a relationship field. This is a required field.

PaymentCreditLine PaymentNumber.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
PaymentCreditLine PaymentNumber.description: Number of the payment credit line payment. This field is automatically generated. Example: PCLP-{000000000}.

PaymentId.description: ID of the applied payment credit. This field is a relationship field.

Type.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort
Type.description: Payment credit type. This is a required field. Possible values are: Applied Unapplied

UnappliedDate.description: Date payment was unapplied. Can be the current date or a provided date.

special_access_rules:
This object is only available in Salesforce Order Management orgs or if the B2B Commerce or D2C Commerce license is enabled. Users require the PaymentCredit and PaymentPlatform permission sets.
